data_note_ambient: 384-well plate SORT-seq inter-well ambient carryover heavy: LYZ 0.8–14.9 ten-thousand CPM, LTF 0.5–5.9 ten-thousand CPM across almost all groups det≈1.0 (T cell cluster also LYZ 8.5k CPM) ⇒ secretory fluid gene reads ≠ cell-autonomous expression; LACRT has ~1.5–5k CPM plate-level environmental background in non-secretory groups (Tcell det 0.97) ⇒ positive reading must use ≥5–10× background (e.g., >20k CPM) rather than absolute detection. LYZ/LTF thus prohibited from any core (data gate RED synchronously verified).
data_note_acinar_zymogen_gap: Acinar classical zymogen program undetectable in this atlas: PRSS1 max 2.3 CPM, CTRB1 6.1, PNLIP 10.7(det 0.00), CTRB2 only in pseudogene soup cluster det 0.02, LIPF/CELA/BHLHA2≈0—true lacrimal acini should be ten-thousand level CPM ⇒ 'acinar' defined by zymogens has no data support, this card defines secretory entry via LACRT+/SCGB+/CST+ seromucous secretion program (layer_descriptor explicitly stated), zymogen gap registered in registry and completion report.
